STATE OF NEW MEXICO
PUBLIC EMPLOYEE LABOR RELATIONS BOARD
In re:
COMMUNICATION WORKERS
of AMERICA,
Petitioner,
and PELRB No. 305-26
UNIVERSITY of NEW MEXICO,
Respondent.
ORDER
THIS MATTER comes before the Public Employee Labor Relations Board at its regularly
scheduled meeting on June 2, 2026, upon a Petition by the union to accrete the position of
General Services Assistant-DH Lawrence Ranch into the existing bargaining unit at the University
of New Mexico. After resolving all questions concerning representation the Executive Director
found that the Petition was supported by an adequate showing of interest. Therefore, the
Executive Director issued an Amended Certification on May 7, 2026, indicating the accretion of
the petitioned-for position. Upon review of the submissions and no one appearing in opposition
to the Amended Certification, the Board, by unanimous vote, hereby affirms and ratifies the
Amended Certification of Representation issued by the Hearing Examiner on May 7, 2026
including the findings therein.
6/9/2026
_____________________________________ Date:_______________
Nan Nash, Board Chair
